title: Invoice totals computed with BigDecimal and one rounding mode
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the repeated setScale calls as redundant, or the record validation as misplaced. Every monetary value is scaled to cents with the same HALF_UP mode at each step — each line is rounded before summing, and tax is rounded once on the subtotal — so the total always equals the sum of the amounts a customer sees; prices are BigDecimals built from strings by callers (never doubles, which cannot represent cents exactly); quantities are multiplied via BigDecimal.valueOf; and the LineItem compact constructor rejects null prices and non-positive quantities at construction, so the calculator can rely on them.
